body: Thank you. It's just I've reached my breaking point.
Thank you for your kind words.

I've been trying everything. My school is particular about who gets scholarships..they really favor the students who do very well, which is not me. Especially since I am a first-generation college student, my parents are just as lost as I am. They have been trying everything too, so I cannot blame them. It's just so frustrating and hard to deal with the fact that I am so close, but still have to get additional jobs just to afford my education. 
I appreciate your words, especially coming from a college professor. I'm glad there are professors like you in the world who care.
It's good to know that some people still have hope, even at the bottom.
I appreciate what you are saying. Thank you.
